Intro title.title: Where elegant design meets uncompromising performance.

Intro lead.paragraph: ONORA Hotel Supplies partners with hotels, restaurants and cafés to source tableware and service equipment that looks exceptional and stands up to the demands of daily hospitality.

Intro body.paragraph: We curate collections from trusted global manufacturers — so every plate, glass and trolley reflects your standards, your style and your guests’ expectations.

style.Intro row: padding: 0px; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 40px; @media(--tablet){ flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: 64px; } @media(--mobile){ flex-direction: column; gap: 48px; }
style.Intro text: flex-direction: column; gap: 28px; padding: 0px; width: 560px; max-width: 100%; align-items: flex-start;
style.Intro actions: padding: 0px; width: auto; gap: 28px; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; @media(--mobile){ gap: 20px; }
style.Intro signature: flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; padding: 0px; width: auto;
style.Intro sig name: font-family: var(--on-serif); font-weight: 600; font-size: 24px; line-height: 26px; letter-spacing: -0.3px; color: var(--on-navy);
style.Intro sig role: font-family: var(--on-sans); font-weight: 500; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.6px; color: var(--on-muted);
style.Intro composition: position: relative; width: 620px; min-width: 620px; height: 680px; padding: 0px; @media(--tablet){ align-self: center; } @media(--mobile){ width: 100%; min-width: 0px; height: 440px; }
style.Intro ring: position: absolute; padding: 0px; border-radius: 50%; border-width: 1.4px; border-style: solid; border-color: rgba(201,150,46,0.5); background: transparent; left: 300px; top: -40px; width: 360px; height: 360px; min-width: 360px; @media(--mobile){ display: none; }
style.Intro main image: position: absolute; left: 200px; top: 0px; width: 420px; height: 560px; object-fit: cover; @media(--mobile){ left: 0px; width: 100%; height: 400px; }
style.Intro detail image: position: absolute; left: 0px; top: 320px; width: 300px; height: 340px; object-fit: cover; border-width: 10px; border-style: solid; border-color: #FFFFFF; @media(--mobile){ display: none; }
style.Intro badge: position: absolute; left: 470px; top: 520px; width: auto; min-width: 232px; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; padding: 20px 26px; background-color: var(--on-navy); @media(--mobile){ left: auto; right: 0px; top: auto; bottom: 0px; padding: 16px 20px; }
style.Intro badge number: font-family: var(--on-serif); font-weight: 600; font-size: 44px; line-height: 44px; letter-spacing: -0.3px; color: #FFFFFF;
style.Intro badge label: font-family: var(--on-sans); font-weight: 600; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 1.8px; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--on-gold-soft);
